name: Session Handoff
description: Captures structured session wrap-ups in the project or ticket notes and surfaces the latest one when TPM resumes.

wrapUpTrigger.label: Wrap Up Trigger
wrapUpTrigger.description: When TPM proposes a session handoff. manual (default): only on explicit signals (e.g. 'wrap up'). auto-on-quiet: also proposes when the conversation goes stale. TPM always proposes before writing, never silently.

surfaceOnResume.label: Surface On Resume
surfaceOnResume.description: When on (default), TPM surfaces the most recent Session Handoff at session start before responding. Off skips this; wrap-up writes still work normally.

sectionsToInclude.label: Sections To Include
sectionsToInclude.description: Sub-sections written under each Session Handoff block, in the listed order. Trim or extend to match your needs.

dateFormat.label: Date Format
dateFormat.description: Date format for each Session Handoff heading. Default YYYY-MM-DD groups by day; use YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM for finer granularity.

cloneTagHeading.label: Clone-Tag Handoff Heading
cloneTagHeading.description: When on (default), handoff headings get a clone suffix ([clone: label @ branch]) for shared clone-family homes. Off always writes the plain heading.
